recruiterCard.summary: Builds the pipelines and validation tooling for a field phenotyping platform that fuses LiDAR with encoder and IMU streams into 3D point clouds and plant traits.
impactBullets: Built Python and Bash pipelines on Linux that have processed 1,950+ scans (about 1 TB) across 50+ projects, cutting runtime from 60–90 to 20–35 minutes.
Developed the validation and research-delivery layer: plot-to-genotype map checks, QC artifacts, byte-identical map snapshots, and auto-generated genotype-ranking plots.
Created a FastAPI pipeline-configuration app with schema introspection, validation previews, and locked-field enforcement, covered by 360+ pytest tests.
Added automated quality checks that flagged 90–110 anomalous scans, validated against manual review with precision and recall.
